queries_run: Levi Strauss direct-to-consumer wholesale channel shift 2026
Levi Strauss go-to-market change 2026 beyond jeans DTC mix third quarter

findings.claim: FY2026 Q3：DTC 淨營收僅 +2%（報告與有機），占總營收 45%，管理層稱 DTC 低於內部預期，預期 Q4 中個位數成長；e-commerce +10%
findings.source: Levi Strauss & Co. Reports Third-Quarter Results (Business Wire/Morningstar, 2026-10-07)
findings.excerpt: DTC net revenues increased 2% on a reported and organic basis. DTC comprised 45% of total net revenues in the third quarter.

findings.claim: Q1 FY2026：DTC 占總淨營收 52%，DTC 成長為成長引擎；同時批發也成長（Q2 10-Q 稱批發量增）
findings.source: FashionUnited, DTC surge drives Levi Strauss to raise annual guidance
findings.excerpt: DTC net revenues rose 16 percent on a reported basis, now accounting for 52 percent of total net revenues for the quarter.

findings.claim: Q2 FY2026 10-Q：批發淨營收在三個月與六個月期間皆成長（報告與有機），主因量增；歐洲量減係因上年德國 Dorsten 配送中心轉換後出貨正常化
findings.excerpt: net revenues in our wholesale channel increased for the three-month and six-month periods ended May 31, 2026 compared with the prior-year periods on a reported and organic net revenues basis primarily due to higher volumes

channel_business_model_shift.note: as_of 之 10-Q 日期為約略（季末後提交），未逐字核對；DTC 占比由 52%（Q1）降至 45%（Q3）受季節性影響，未做解讀。Q1 DTC 成長數字不同來源 16% vs 10% 不一致。
